Tara N: Heads-up  CloudPartnerAtlas wants a 50m "onramp roadshow" for their partner SIs next month to cover our ref-arch, Terraform modules, and marketplace packaging. Aim: hands-on lab + submission checklist. Who can lead each piece?
Moe S: I can run the ref-arch section and cover differences across Hosted/Dedicated/Private (10m). I'll include a one-slide KMS + data-flow diagram since partners always ask.
Ishaan P: I'll own the Terraform lab (25m). Plan: tiny module to provision network + instance pool + runtime config. Flow will be: git clone -> terraform init/plan/apply -> smoke check. Keep it resilient to low quotas.
Luca V: I'll handle marketplace packaging and the asset manifest example (10m). Will prepare a manifest template, icon size checklist, license note, and support contact fields. Also include a short note on telemetry/telemetry_endpoint expected by marketplace.
Tara N: Nice. Add a 5-minute QA/runbook segment for ops playbook (on-call steps, rollback, failover). Partners want a concise evacuation and rollback checklist.
Ishaan P: Terraform snippet for the demo:
```hcl
module "atlas_inference" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-refkits//cloudpartneratlas/terraform/onramp-mini"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = "g5.xlarge"
  min_nodes = 1
  max_nodes = 2
  enable_kms = true
  kms_key_arn = var.kms_key_arn
}
```
Moe S: I'll add a short IAM least-priv policy snippet and an audit-log pointer. Also will include a slide about routing policies + fallback region config.
Luca V: For marketplace packaging I'll include a sample manifest.yaml and a quick checklist: icons, screenshots, short description, support_url, sla_tier, telemetry_endpoint, and license. I'll also note the packaging owner who must respond to marketplace review comments.
Tara N: Can infra create a partner sandbox project for rehearsal? Request name: atlas-onramp-2026-06-12, creds TTL 48h. Who files the infra ticket?
Moe S: I can file the infra ticket today. Tagging infra to add Ishaan and Luca as collaborators.
enablement-bot: Event created: 2026-06-12 15:00 UTC. Rehearsal scheduled: 2026-06-11 15:00 UTC. Sandbox request link: <https://infra.internal/new_request?proj=atlas-onramp-2026-06-12>. Enablement checklist: <https://git.internal/redwood/partner-refkits/cloudpartneratlas/enablement-checklist.md>.
Ishaan P: I'll add a troubleshooting section in the README (common quota errors, security group rules, model pull auth). Will push a PR to repos/partner-refkits/cloudpartneratlas/terraform/onramp-mini by EOD tomorrow.
Luca V: I'll draft the manifest.yaml example and icon assets and open the packaging PR. Also will prepare a 1-page handout for partners with runbook highlights.
Tara N: Owners: Moe (ref-arch + KMS slide), Ishaan (terraform + docs + smoke tests), Luca (marketplace packaging + handout), Tara (coord + rehearsal). Rehearse 24h before. Post PR links and rehearsal notes here. :rocket:
Moe S: +1. I'll also add a short slide on cost/instance sizing guidance for partners (expected throughput per node).
Ishaan P: Sounds good. I'll include a small smoke-test script under tests/smoke/check.sh and a PromQL alert example for token latency > 250ms.
Luca V: Great  I'll include guidance about versioning the module and semantic versioning notes in the manifest.
Tara N: Thanks team  let's circle back when PRs are up.
